title: Keyboard manager broke down after latest update
author: AlienStudent

status.label: Waiting for current-version confirmation
status.detail: The author reported an old failure, later said a different mapping plus laptop restart worked, and a maintainer asked for a 0.100.2+ retest. No response followed.

next_action: Await the existing current-version and numbered-repro request before creating a competing fix investigation.

judgment.rationale: The reporter described old shortcut-to-text failures and then said changing to Ctrl+Shift+comma/period and restarting restored operation. The latest maintainer request asks whether the issue persists on 0.100.2 or newer and requests numbered steps; there is no author response. Similar-issue suggestions are not proof of a covering fix for this report.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.84.1 and mappings Ctrl+NumPad1 to > and Ctrl+NumPad3 to <; after an update, remaps sometimes produced the prior shortcut's output or stopped working.
The author later said changing to Ctrl+Shift+comma/period and restarting the laptop made the remaps work, but did not identify why the prior setup failed.
A later commenter reports the UI showed saved mappings while resetup complained the mapping was missing; that comment does not establish the author's current status.
The July 19, 2026 maintainer request asks whether it persists on 0.100.2 or newer and requests numbered steps; no later author response appears.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the requested current-build confirmation and exact reproducer; if it persists, reassess the saved mapping and shortcut-to-text output rather than assuming a duplicate.
requested_evidence: Whether the failure persists on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer
Numbered steps and exact mapping that produces stale or missing output

fix_assessment.rationale: The report's author described a workaround and no current-build failure is confirmed. No new code change should be proposed until the unanswered retest establishes that the original behavior persists.

issue_context.summary: After an update, Keyboard Manager shortcut-to-text mappings sometimes stopped working or emitted output from a prior mapping; the author later reported that changing the shortcuts and restarting restored behavior.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.84.1 and Ctrl+NumPad1 to > / Ctrl+NumPad3 to < mappings.
The author later changed them to Ctrl+Shift+comma/period and restarted the laptop; the new mappings worked.
A separate commenter says resetup reported a mapping missing even though the UI showed it.
A maintainer requested a 0.100.2-or-newer retest and numbered reproduction steps on July 19, 2026; no author response followed.
inferences: The original failure could involve a conflict with Edge's native shortcuts, stale shortcut-to-text state, or persisted mapping data, but the thread does not establish which mechanism caused it.
The later workaround may avoid a shortcut conflict, but it does not confirm whether the original failure persists on current PowerToys.
issue_context.analysis: The author's workaround reduced the immediate impact but did not identify a root cause, and the issue remains open without a current-build retest. Similar reports include closed intermittent regressions and duplicates of #17344, but none proves this exact shortcut-to-text behavior is covered. Preserve the existing unanswered request and reassess on response.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all four comments, including the author's workaround and the separate resetup report.
Checked suggested issue #28994; it was closed after the reporter said the transient failure stopped after version changes.
Checked #34510, #29300, and #33254; they were closed as duplicates of #17344 and do not establish coverage for this exact stale-output behavior.
Confirmed the July 19, 2026 current-build request remains unanswered.

information_gaps.information: Whether the original shortcut-to-text failure persists on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer and, if so, numbered steps with the exact source shortcuts and observed output.
information_gaps.why_needed: The reporter found a workaround on an older build, so current impact and whether the stale-output behavior remains are unknown.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the original mappings on 0.100.2 or newer and provide numbered steps and the exact text produced by each mapping.
